discovery: Record S35 in the completed frozen retrieval, adcontextprotocol/adcp-client issue464, closed by merged PR461.
question: Does restoring fields by extracting an error code from prose also restore the original structured error detail?
planned_boundary: Unchanged TypeScript source functions compiled with the TypeScript compiler and controlled external collaborators; no hand-reimplementation of the conversion/extraction logic.
inputs: Controller error shape from public issue and original source: text=Controller error: CODE, structuredContent includes success=false, error=CODE, error_detail. Use UNKNOWN_SCENARIO, INVALID_PARAMS, NOT_FOUND and paired distinct details with the same code; success and directly available structured data as controls.
oracle: Check typed/code fields separately from exact original detail. Retain the emitted reconstructed object; do not infer recovery accuracy from field presence. Compare before and after, and distinguish a raw-data path from a flattened-error path.
limits: Source-shaped controls, not production recordings. An error-detail mismatch is a task-relative limitation of reconstruction, not evidence the maintainers promised every detail or that a new defect has been confirmed. No full AdCP deployment or model inference.
